title: Add keyboard selection navigation to search results
description:
Implement full keyboard navigation for Meridian search results.

Requirements:
- ArrowDown/ArrowUp move a single visible highlight through every actionable row in the active search popup, across Open Tabs, Bookmarks, History, and Web sections.
- Enter and the magnifier open the highlighted result when one is selected; otherwise retain the current default-submit behavior.
- Navigation wraps or clamps consistently, scrolls the active row into view, and resets safely when the query, scope, popup contents, or popup visibility changes.
- Mouse hover/click and keyboard selection remain synchronized without stale selection after asynchronous result replacement.
- Escape behavior and persisted query behavior must remain unchanged.
- Preserve pinned-versus-unpinned URL navigation and direct-URL recognition.
- Apply changes to root and meridian-extension mirrors.
- Add regression tests for Up/Down, cross-section movement, Enter activation, async replacement, empty results, and scoped popups.
label: Feature

activity.content:
## Completed

Implemented full keyboard selection navigation for Meridian search results in both the root source and `meridian-extension` mirror.

- Added a shared popup selection controller with wrapped Up/Down movement, one visible active row, nearest-row scrolling, pointer synchronization, activation, and safe reset behavior.
- Routed Enter and the magnifier through the highlighted row first while preserving default web/scoped submit behavior when no row is selected.
- Integrated selection across Open Tabs, Bookmarks, History, Web, and scoped bookmarks/history popups.
- Reset selection on query/scope changes, popup open/close, content rendering, async result replacement, and clearing.
- Preserved existing Escape/query behavior, direct URL recognition, and pinned-versus-unpinned navigation.
- Added regression coverage for Up/Down wrapping, cross-section traversal, Enter/magnifier activation, async replacement, empty results, pointer synchronization, and scoped popup rows.

Validation: `node --test` - 69 passed, 0 failed. `git diff --check` passed. Root/mirror parity passed.
